# Standard Grow

> Standard Grow, by Standard Trade, is a number you text a reel to. It sends back ads and a budget for your business, runs them once you approve, and reports what they brought in.

Standard Grow is operated by Standard Trade (https://standardtrade.ai). Your first growth test is free.

## Answers

- [Do faceless TikTok slideshows work for a new business?](https://grow.standardtrade.ai/experiments/faceless-tiktok-slideshows): Our test: 13 faceless TikTok slideshows on 4 new accounts got 742 views and no sign-ups in 2 days. What worked, what got 0 views, and what we changed.
- [How is Standard Grow growing? Real numbers](https://grow.standardtrade.ai/ledger): Standard Grow's growth numbers, published as we go: 742 TikTok views, 2 sign-ups and $0 ad spend as of 27 Oct 2026.
- [What growth experiments has Standard Grow run?](https://grow.standardtrade.ai/experiments): Every reel Standard Grow turned into a growth experiment for its own business, with the breakdown, budget and real results.
- [What is Standard Grow? The text-a-reel growth service](https://grow.standardtrade.ai/what-is-standard-grow): Standard Grow (grow.standardtrade.ai) turns a reel you text it into a ready-to-run ad test for your business. First test free. Not the grow tent or agency plan.
- [Can I text a reel and get an ad test for my store?](https://grow.standardtrade.ai/text-a-reel): Yes: text a reel to Standard Grow and get back your version of the ad, a budget and a win condition, run after you approve. Compared with AdGraam and others.
